mapping.summary: Warehouse extension for combining orders and shipments, batch shipment creation and handling units.
claims: Profiles set parameters for shipping, receiving and invoicing
Combines several orders into one shipment or receipt document
Combines shipments or return receipts into one invoice
User-defined grouping codes control how documents are combined
Previews how documents will be grouped before posting
Closes uninvoiced shipments or receipts automatically or manually
Creates warehouse shipments and receipts in batch
Worksheet to simulate and plan shipments and receipts
Multi-level handling units such as pallets and boxes
Handling units can be made mandatory on transactions
Handling units work across sales, purchase, transfer, adjustment, warehouse and production documents
Handling unit transactions are logged in their own ledger
Prints handling unit contents and packing lists
Packing instructions are generated from predefined rules
Non-item lines can be shipped on warehouse shipments
Partially posted warehouse shipments and receipts can be deleted
Integrates with the publisher's Italian e-invoicing app
